scope: Original cursor texture and screen-space quad reproduced in the new menu integration host. Win32 pointer tracking replaces the unreconstructed client input subsystem.
runtime_observation: User confirmed original cursor visibility and mouse tracking over the artwork. This does not verify new text or Exit integration.

instruction_anchors.meaning: Child-window getter returns HWND and cleans stack self
Texture loader cleans self, primary name, secondary name, flags and output pointer
Texture binder returns a bool in AL and cleans self, texture and stage
Viewport setter copies six DWORDs
Viewport setter cleans self and record pointer
Vertex format 1 uses D3DFVF_XYZRHW, diffuse, specular and one UV set
Screen-space vertex stride is 32 bytes
Primitive draw cleans self, kind, count, vertices and format
Loaded graphics texture is a wrapper, not the raw texture interface
Wrapper slot zero decrements its reference count
Wrapper Release cleans self
Original cursor loads x_kursor.tga with flags 0x402
Cursor width normalization constant 1/1024
Cursor height normalization constant 1/768
Cursor extent at reference resolution is 30 pixels
Screen-space cursor z bits are 0x3ce8bf06
Cursor reciprocal-W bits are 0x420cc9df
Original viewport record starts at initialized x/y/width/height/minZ/maxZ
Bind cursor texture to stage zero
Original quad is kind 4, two primitives, vertex format 1

intentional_boundaries: New integration glue, not a complete reconstruction of either original cursor function.
Pointer coordinates come from Win32 GetCursorPos/ScreenToClient on the verified engine child HWND; no original input subsystem is invoked.
Cursor is drawn after the scene and before Present, in its own BeginScene/EndScene pair as in the original caller.
Draw only while the host is foreground and the pointer is inside the render child client area; no pointer capture or confinement.
The original cursor model/control binding is not needed for this bounded textured-quad renderer and is not reconstructed.
No menu click behavior, fonts or localized text are implemented by this cursor.
